title: A Kite for Sam
text:
Sam has a new kite. It is blue and very big. He takes it to the park on Sunday. The wind is strong today.

Sam runs fast across the grass. The kite flies high in the sky. His sister Ola watches and claps. Sam smiles because he is happy.

questions.text: Why is Sam smiling at the end?
options: He is happy because the kite flies high

questions.text: Why is the wind important for Sam's kite?
options: It helps the kite fly high

vocabulary.definition: a toy that flies in the air on a string
the space above the earth where birds and planes fly

paragraph_translations: Sam ma nowego latawca. Jest niebieski i bardzo duży. W niedzielę zabiera go do parku. Dzisiaj wieje mocny wiatr.
Sam biegnie szybko po trawie. Latawiec leci wysoko na niebie. Jego siostra Ola patrzy i klaszcze. Sam się uśmiecha, bo jest szczęśliwy.
